Instead, written in precise, elegant script, were coordinates pointing directly to his own remote tower and a single sentence: 'Keep the light burning; we are finally coming home.'", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市尚在沉睡，夜色如墨，却已悄然晕开微光。街道空荡而寂静，昏黄的路灯拖着长长的影子，只有洒水车悠扬的音乐在冷冽的空气中回荡。环卫工人的扫帚摩擦着路面，沙沙作响；早点铺的蒸笼腾起第一缕白雾，温柔地唤醒了人间的烟火气。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a rule or task solves a big problem by repeating itself on smaller and smaller versions of the same thing.\n• Imagine standing between two parallel mirrors: you see an endless reflection of yourself holding another reflection inside it.\n• Every recursion must have a stopping rule, just like stopping unwrapping nesting dolls when you finally reach the tiny solid wooden baby inside."}
